Hi Ellie —

Thanks for the clear brief and the manifest. This thread landed in my queue; copying Marissa (ops) and Ben (sales) to align on milestones and contracting cadence. Quick answers and a proposed MAP below.

Redwood constraints (standard for evaluation exchanges):
- Data use: access for evaluation only; no training or model-weight usage permitted (we include a short usage covenant in the MAP)
- Retention: sandbox copies are ephemeral and will be purged 30 days after handover unless we agree to an extension in writing
- Access: ephemeral API keys + scoped role-based access; audit logs retained for 90 days for the pilot

Proposed MAP milestones (suggested dates):
1) Finalize MAP doc & mutual redlines — target Dec 4
2) Sample handover (SFTP or secure Drive link) — target Dec 8
3) Sandbox provisioning & test ingest — Dec 9–10
4) Acceptance window & evaluation run — Dec 11–Dec 31
5) Close decision & next steps — target Jan 5, 2027

I've attached Redwood's provisioning doc (redwood_provision_instructions.pdf) with the ingestion checklist and minimum schema expectations. If this timeline looks good we'll route the MAP for signature (we support DocuSign).

Notes: please ensure the sample manifest marks any PII and provide the sanitized column mapping; we'll honor the ephemeral constraint in the MAP language.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
